chunks: As a provision for men, and enlivened a region that was dead. Even thus will be the life after death.
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran use the revival of dead land as a metaphor for resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a dual reference to both physical resurrection and the spiritual revival of the hearts of believers through divine revelation. The phrase 'a dead land' is frequently linked to the era of ignorance preceding the Prophet Muhammad, emphasizing how the descent of rain (or the Imam) brings life to barren souls. This analogy underscores the tangible reality of the Hereafter by pointing to the observable natural cycle of renewal.
